name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat.|Grip just wider than shoulders, pull shoulder blades together.|Lower the bar to the lower chest under control.|Press up and slightly back until arms are straight.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest|Flaring elbows to 90 degrees|Lifting hips off the bench
tips: Keep wrists stacked over elbows.|Drive feet into the floor.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit with dumbbells on thighs, lie back and bring them to chest height.|Press up until arms are straight over the chest.|Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
mistakes: Letting dumbbells drift wide|Dropping too fast
tips: Keep elbows about 45 degrees from the body.|Squeeze the chest at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells at upper chest.|Press up and slightly together.|Lower under control to a deep stretch.
mistakes: Bench set too steep (turns into a shoulder press)|Arching the lower back
tips: 30 degrees is plenty for the upper chest.|Keep shoulder blades pinned back.

name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30 degrees, unrack the bar over the upper chest.|Lower to the upper chest.|Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Bar path drifting toward the face|Bouncing off the chest
tips: Use a spotter or safety arms.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles line up with mid chest.|Press handles forward until arms are almost straight.|Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
mistakes: Seat too high or low|Shrugging shoulders forward
tips: Keep your back flat against the pad.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set pulleys at chest height, step forward with a slight bend in the elbows.|Bring hands together in a wide hugging arc.|Open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
mistakes: Turning it into a press|Going too heavy and losing the arc
tips: Keep the elbow bend fixed through the rep.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Set the seat so handles are at chest height.|Bring the handles together in front of you.|Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.
tips: Pause for a second when the handles meet.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line.|Lower the chest to just above the floor.|Push back up without letting the hips sag.
tips: Squeeze glutes and abs the whole time.|Raise your hands on a bench to make it easier.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip the bars, lean the torso forward slightly.|Lower until upper arms are about parallel to the floor.|Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Going too deep with sore shoulders|Staying fully upright (shifts work to triceps)
tips: Stop the dip where your shoulders feel comfortable.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip just wider than shoulders.|Pull your chest up toward the bar, driving elbows down.|Lower to a full hang under control.
mistakes: Half reps|Swinging or kipping|Shrugging at the top
tips: Start each rep by pulling the shoulder blades down.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang with an underhand shoulder-width grip.|Pull until your chin clears the bar.|Lower to a full hang.
mistakes: Not reaching full hang|Leaning back too far
tips: Keep ribs down and legs still.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs locked under the pad, grip wide.|Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows down and back.|Let the bar rise slowly until arms are straight.
mistakes: Leaning back and swinging|Pulling the bar behind the neck
tips: Think about pulling your elbows to your back pockets.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, bar hanging below the knees.|Row the bar to your lower ribs.|Lower under control.
tips: Keep your torso angle fixed through the set.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one hand and knee on the bench, dumbbell in the other hand.|Row the dumbbell to your hip.|Lower to a full stretch.
mistakes: Twisting the torso|Short range of motion
tips: Lead with the elbow, not the hand.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with a slight knee bend, grab the handle.|Pull to the lower ribs, squeezing shoulder blades.|Return slowly and stretch forward without rounding.
tips: Pause for a second at the squeeze.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Set the cable at upper-chest height with a rope.|Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high.|Rotate hands back and out at the end.
tips: Good for rear delts and shoulder health.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with a straight bar, arms nearly straight.|Pull the bar down to your thighs.|Return slowly overhead.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown|Leaning too far forward
tips: Think of sweeping the bar with your lats.

name: Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Bar at collarbone height, grip just outside shoulders.|Squeeze glutes and press the bar overhead, moving your head back then through.|Lower to the collarbone.
mistakes: Leaning back excessively|Pressing the bar out in front
tips: Finish with the bar over mid-foot and ribs down.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Set the bench upright, dumbbells at shoulder height.|Press overhead until arms are straight.|Lower to ear level.
mistakes: Arching the lower back|Flaring elbows way out
tips: Keep forearms vertical.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles start at shoulder height.|Press up to near straight arms.|Lower with control.
mistakes: Seat too low|Shrugging at the top
tips: Good for beginners or when fatigued.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, slight elbow bend.|Raise arms out to the sides to shoulder height.|Lower slowly.
mistakes: Swinging the weights|Raising above shoulder height with shrugged traps
tips: Lead with the elbows.|Use lighter weights than you think.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable, hand across the body.|Raise the arm out to shoulder height.|Lower slowly.
tips: Constant tension makes this great for side delts.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Face the pad, set handles at shoulder height.|Open arms wide, squeezing rear delts.|Return slowly.
tips: Keep arms nearly straight and chest on the pad.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging.|Raise arms out to the sides.|Lower with control.
tips: Lighter weight, slow reps.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall, shoulder-width underhand grip.|Curl the bar up without moving the elbows forward.|Lower slowly to full extension.
tips: Squeeze at the top.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.|Curl both up, keeping elbows still.|Lower slowly.
tips: Rotate the palm up as you lift.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing in.|Curl up keeping the neutral grip.|Lower slowly.
tips: Hits the brachialis and forearms too.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low cable with a straight or EZ bar.|Curl up keeping elbows by your sides.|Lower slowly.
tips: Constant tension all the way through.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips.|Curl up with elbows pinned.|Lower to full extension.
tips: Easier on the wrists than a straight bar.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand at a high cable, elbows pinned to your sides.|Push down until arms are straight.|Return until forearms are just past parallel.
tips: Squeeze for a second at the bottom.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Face away from a low cable, rope behind the head.|Extend arms forward and up.|Return slowly to a deep stretch.
tips: Great for the long head of the triceps.

name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on the bench holding the bar over your chest.|Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.|Extend back up.
mistakes: Elbows flaring|Letting the bar drift back too far
tips: Lower slightly behind the head for constant tension.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip the bar about shoulder width.|Lower to the lower chest with elbows tucked.|Press up.
tips: Shoulder-width grip is enough.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Hands on the bench behind you, legs out front.|Lower by bending elbows to about 90 degrees.|Press back up.
tips: Bend the knees to make it easier.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.|Brace your core and sit down between your hips.|Descend until thighs are at least parallel.|Drive up through mid-foot.
mistakes: Knees caving in|Heels lifting|Chest dropping forward
tips: Take a big breath and brace before each rep.|Use safety arms.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Bar on the front shoulders, elbows high.|Squat down keeping the torso upright.|Stand back up.
tips: Needs good wrist and shoulder mobility.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest.|Squat down between your knees keeping the chest tall.|Stand back up.
tips: Great for learning squat form.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit with back flat and feet shoulder width on the platform.|Lower the sled until knees are about 90 degrees or deeper without your hips lifting.|Press up without locking out hard.
mistakes: Hips curling off the seat|Locking knees aggressively|Cutting depth short
tips: Feet lower on the plate = more quads.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on the platform with shoulders under the pads.|Lower until thighs are below parallel.|Drive back up.
tips: A feet-low stance hits the quads harder.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the pad to sit just above the ankles.|Extend the knees until legs are straight.|Lower slowly.
tips: Pause at the top.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.|Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor.|Push through the front foot and step into the next rep.
tips: Keep the torso tall.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot on the bench, front foot about a stride ahead.|Lower the back knee toward the floor.|Drive up through the front heel.
mistakes: Front foot too close|Leaning too far forward
tips: Start with bodyweight to find your stance.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar.|Squat down to parallel or below.|Stand back up.
mistakes: Feet directly under the bar (strains knees)|Rounding forward
tips: A good option if barbell squats are uncomfortable.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the bar at hip level.|Push hips back with soft knees, bar sliding down the thighs.|Lower to mid-shin or until hamstrings stretch.|Drive hips forward to stand.
mistakes: Rounding the back|Bar drifting away from legs
tips: Think hips back, not down.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs.|Hinge at hips, lowering the weights along the legs.|Stand tall squeezing glutes.
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging|Rounding the back
tips: Keep the weights close.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down, pad just above the heels.|Curl the heels to your glutes.|Lower slowly.
tips: Slow lowering (3 seconds) boosts the result.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the pad above the ankles and the thigh pad snug.|Curl legs back under the seat.|Return slowly.
tips: Pause at peak contraction.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on the bench, bar over hips (use a pad).|Drive through heels, lifting hips until the body is flat.|Lower under control.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back|Feet too far away
tips: Tuck the chin and finish with a glute squeeze.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.|Lift hips until the body is straight from knee to shoulder.|Lower slowly.
tips: Add a dumbbell on the hips to progress.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the legs.|Pull the slack out and brace the core.|Push the floor away, keeping the bar close to your legs.|Lock out hips and knees together, then lower under control.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back|Bar drifting forward|Jerking the bar off the floor
tips: Think leg press the floor away.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable.|Kick the leg back in a controlled arc.|Return slowly.
tips: Small, controlled range.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Set the pads on your shoulders, balls of feet on the platform.|Lower the heels for a deep stretch.|Rise onto your toes and pause.
tips: Pause for 1-2 seconds at the stretch and the top.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with pads on your thighs, balls of feet on the platform.|Lower heels to a stretch.|Rise up and pause.
tips: Targets the soleus.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in the leg press, only the balls of the feet on the platform.|Press the toes away.|Return for a deep stretch.
tips: Great if you have no calf machine.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on a step edge, hold a rail.|Lower the heel below the step.|Rise as high as you can.
tips: Hold a dumbbell to progress.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.|Body in one straight line.|Hold, breathing steadily.
mistakes: Hips sagging or piking|Holding the breath
tips: Squeeze glutes and pull ribs down.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar.|Raise your knees toward the chest, tilting the pelvis.|Lower with control.
tips: Curl the pelvis up at the top.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel at a high cable holding a rope by the head.|Crunch down, bringing elbows toward the thighs.|Return slowly.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms|Hinging at the hips only
tips: Round the spine, don't just bow.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, knees at 90 degrees.|Lower opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays flat.|Return and switch sides.
tips: Small range if the back lifts.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height, handle at the chest.|Press the handle straight out.|Hold, then bring it back without twisting.
mistakes: Letting the torso rotate|Standing too close
tips: Anti-rotation core work.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat Deadlift
instructions: Stand wide with toes out, hold one dumbbell between the legs.|Sit hips down and back to lower it.|Stand up squeezing glutes.
tips: Good beginner deadlift pattern.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet a little wider than shoulders, kettlebell in front.|Hinge and hike the bell back between the legs.|Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
mistakes: Squatting the swing|Lifting with the arms
tips: The hips do the work, the arms just guide.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders.|Squat down.|Drive up and press the weights overhead in one motion.
mistakes: Pressing before the legs finish|Leaning back
tips: Good for conditioning.

name: SkiErg (1000 m)
instructions: Stand tall, handles at head height.|Pull down with straight arms using lats and core, hinge slightly.|Return to the top smoothly.
mistakes: Arms only, no hips|Starting too fast
tips: Aim for a steady rhythm, then push the last 200 m.

name: Sled Push (50 m)
instructions: Hands on the sled posts, body at about 45 degrees.|Drive with short, powerful steps.|Keep pushing, do not stop to rest.
tips: Stay low and keep steps quick.

name: Sled Pull (50 m)
instructions: Face the sled, grab the rope, sit slightly back.|Pull hand over hand while stepping backward.|Keep the rope tight.
tips: Use legs and a back-lean, not just arms.

name: Burpee Broad Jump
instructions: Drop into a burpee, chest to floor.|Stand, and jump forward as far as you comfortably can.|Land and go straight into the next burpee.
mistakes: Going out too hard|Small jumps with big rests
tips: Aim for a steady pace you can hold for 80 m.

name: Rowing (1000 m)
instructions: Legs drive first, then lean back, then pull the arms.|Return: arms away, hinge forward, then bend the knees.|Hold a steady stroke rate.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms first|Rushing the recovery
tips: Sequence is legs, body, arms - then arms, body, legs.

name: Farmer's Carry (200 m)
instructions: Pick up the weights, stand tall, shoulders back.|Walk with quick, even steps.|Set down only when you need to.
tips: Take a firm grip and breathe steadily.

name: Sandbag Lunges (100 m)
instructions: Sandbag across the shoulders.|Step forward into a lunge, back knee touching down.|Stand up and repeat.
tips: Keep the torso upright and breathe.

name: Wall Ball (100 reps)
instructions: Hold the ball at chest, squat to depth.|Drive up and throw to the target.|Catch and go straight into the next squat.
tips: Break the set before you are gassed.

name: A-Skips
instructions: Skip forward, driving one knee up to hip height.|Land on the ball of the foot under the hips.|Alternate with quick arm swings.
tips: Stay tall and bounce.

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place or forward, lifting knees to hip height.|Quick ground contact, pumping arms.
tips: Keep it quick and light.

name: Strides (20 s)
instructions: Accelerate smoothly over 20 seconds to about 90% effort.|Stay relaxed and tall.|Walk back to recover.
tips: Do them after easy runs to build speed.

name: Running Bounds
instructions: Push off one leg into an exaggerated running stride.|Land on the opposite foot and repeat.
tips: Focus on springy, powerful strides.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee, other foot in front.|Tuck the pelvis and lean forward gently.|Hold 30-45 seconds each side.
mistakes: Arching the lower back|Pushing into pain
tips: Squeeze the glute on the kneeling side.

name: Thoracic Extension Over Bench
instructions: Kneel with elbows on the bench.|Sink the chest toward the floor.|Hold and breathe.
tips: Helpful for rounded shoulders.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Lunge forward, hands inside the front foot.|Rotate and reach one arm to the ceiling.|Alternate sides.
mistakes: Rushing the rotation|Dropping the back knee
tips: Move slowly and breathe.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Hands on a wall, one leg back with heel down.|Lean in until you feel the stretch.|Hold 30 seconds.
tips: Bend the back knee slightly to target the soleus.

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: On hands and knees, round the spine up.|Then arch it down.|Move slowly with your breath.
tips: Good warm-up for the spine.
